t: The first state to bear the name Turk, a steppe khaganate that at its peak stretched from Manchuria towards the Black Sea.
It protected Silk Road trade, drew large silk tribute from China and left the Orkhon Inscriptions, the oldest major Turkic texts.
Rival claimants under lateral succession and Chinese divide-and-rule broke it twice; the Uyghurs ended it for good in 744.
dyk: According to the Orkhon Inscriptions, Ilterish Qaghan began rebuilding the fallen Turkic empire in 682 with just seventeen men in the Yin Shan mountains.
ev: Bumin destroys the Rouran and declares himself Qaghan of the Turks
The Gokturks send their first embassy to Constantinople, led by the Sogdian Maniakh
Gokturk forces reach the Crimea and besiege the Byzantine city of Bosporus
The First Khaganate splits into eastern and western halves
Tang China conquers the Eastern Khaganate and captures Illig Qaghan
Ilterish Qaghan founds the Second Khaganate through guerrilla warfare
Bilge Qaghan is poisoned by one of his own ministers
Uyghurs, Karluks and Basmyls seize Otuken and kill the last Gokturk qaghan
